result.title: Posterior Flow Matching
result.summary: Flow matching learns how to transport noise toward data, but its mean prediction does not directly report the endpoint uncertainty remaining at an intermediate state. This paper introduces Posterior Flow Matching (PFM), a general generative modeling framework that learns conditional velocity means and componentwise variances with a Gaussian posterior model. The same model evaluation supplies both a transport prediction and endpoint uncertainty, making posterior diagnostics available throughout generation. These learned moments support a mean-driven ordinary differential equation (ODE) and a posterior-driven stochastic differential equation (SDE), whose local noise scales adapt to the predicted uncertainty. Across image, point-cloud, molecular, and action generation, PFM improves generation quality and provides endpoint-posterior readouts throughout generation.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Posterior Flow Matching 框架，用高斯后验模型同时学习条件速度均值与逐分量方差，使同一次模型评估既给出传输预测又给出终点不确定性，并据此构造均值驱动的 ODE 与噪声尺度随预测不确定性自适应的后验驱动 SDE，在图像、点云、分子与动作生成上验证效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 「在中间状态即可读出终点不确定性」的机制，可能与 LVR 中基于置信度的 STOP 决策、latent 状态更新的不确定性感知相呼应，可供核查；但论文属连续生成建模，与 VLM 推理无直接联系，迁移设想需自行验证。
